representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Independently checked the endpoint_correspondence claim in both directions. In the pinned library EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) abbreviates PiLp 2, whose inner product is the finite coordinate sum; single j 1 is 1 at j and zero elsewhere. Thus dx is the actual coordinate partial, duu its repeated same-coordinate partial, dut the spatial derivative of dt, lap the componentwise sum, and density the specified Euclidean/Frobenius square without 1/2. Fin n reindexes all n coordinates. Scoped ContDiff ∞ is the inner ℕ∞ top coerced into WithTop ℕ∞; contDiffOn_infty states equivalence with all finite orders, and IsOpen.contDiffOn_iff removes any boundary ambiguity on the open positive-time domain. Any source u extends to nonpositive times, and restriction recovers the source map; positive-time neighborhoods make every used derivative independent of the extension, including repeated derivatives. No second Lean model is crossed by this source identification. iteratedFDeriv is the recursive multilinear derivative, not a formal label: on this smooth finite-dimensional domain its coordinate evaluations give all mixed partials, and multilinearity gives the converse vanishing assertion. sectionGood unfolds to continuity, a finite box bound, pointwise vanishing off the same C, and integrability. Pinned PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp/toLp verifies standard product Lebesgue normalization; the empty-coordinate Euclidean volume is dirac 0 of mass one. T006 explicitly requires a genuine measurable equivalence, its coordinate formula, and pushforward equality to the stated product measure. Its inverse is the source coordinate insertion; it identifies the boxes in both directions, including n=1. T007 explicitly plans the restriction and interval-integral conversions. ENNReal.ofReal ((2*R)^n) faithfully records nonnegative finite box volume since R>0. Mathlib's integral and deriv are total, but T003 supplies integrability, T004/T005 supply actual HasDerivAt facts, and P additionally requires DifferentiableAt. For these real integrable functions the Bochner integral agrees with the finite Lebesgue integral, also after completion. No target theorem is concealed in a definition or construction field; T006 is a worker obligation, not an assumed bridge.
